parameters.content:
## Patient API - Create Clinic Booking Invoice

Creates a pending Clinic invoice tied to a placeholder booking. The booking becomes Waiting and receives a queue number only after Telegram payment approval.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    c.id AS clinic_id,
    c.name AS clinic_name,
    c.consultation_fee,

    CASE
        WHEN so.is_closed = 1 THEN NULL
        WHEN so.replacement_doctor_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN replacement_doctor.full_name
        ELSE d.full_name
    END AS doctor_name,

    sh.name AS shift,

    COALESCE(
        so.override_start_time,
        sh.start_time
    ) AS start_time,

    COALESCE(
        so.override_end_time,
        sh.end_time
    ) AS end_time,

    CASE
        WHEN so.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS has_override,

    so.reason AS override_reason,

    CURDATE() AS today_date,
    CURTIME() AS now_time

FROM clinics c

INNER JOIN schedules s
    ON s.clinic_id = c.id

INNER JOIN shifts sh
    ON sh.id = s.shift_id

LEFT JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = s.doctor_id

LEFT JOIN schedule_overrides so
    ON so.override_date = CURDATE()
    AND so.clinic_id = c.id
    AND so.shift_id = sh.id
    AND so.is_active = 1

LEFT JOIN doctors replacement_doctor
    ON replacement_doctor.id = so.replacement_doctor_id

WHERE c.id = $1

  AND c.is_active = 1
  AND s.is_active = 1

  AND s.day_of_week =
      CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())
          WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
          WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
          WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
          WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
          WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
          WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
          WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'
      END

  AND CURTIME() >=
      COALESCE(so.override_start_time, sh.start_time)

  AND CURTIME() <
      COALESCE(so.override_end_time, sh.end_time)

  AND COALESCE(so.is_closed, 0) = 0

LIMIT 1;

SELECT

        MAX(queue_number),
        0
    ) + 1 AS next_queue_number
FROM bookings
WHERE booking_date = CURDATE()
  AND doctor_id = $1
  AND shift_id = $2;

SELECT

    CASE
        WHEN so.is_closed = 1 THEN NULL
        WHEN so.replacement_doctor_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN replacement_doctor.full_name
        ELSE d.full_name
    END AS doctor_name,

    COALESCE(
        so.replacement_doctor_id,
        s.doctor_id
    ) AS doctor_id,

    sh.id AS shift_id,
    sh.name AS shift,

    s.id AS schedule_id,
    so.id AS schedule_override_id,

    COALESCE(
        so.override_start_time,
        sh.start_time
    ) AS start_time,

    COALESCE(
        so.override_end_time,
        sh.end_time
    ) AS end_time

FROM clinics c

INNER JOIN schedules s
    ON s.clinic_id = c.id

INNER JOIN shifts sh
    ON sh.id = s.shift_id

LEFT JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = s.doctor_id

LEFT JOIN schedule_overrides so
    ON so.override_date = CURDATE()
    AND so.clinic_id = c.id
    AND so.shift_id = sh.id
    AND so.is_active = 1

LEFT JOIN doctors replacement_doctor
    ON replacement_doctor.id = so.replacement_doctor_id

WHERE c.id = $1
  AND c.is_active = 1
  AND s.is_active = 1

 AND s.day_of_week =
    CASE DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE())
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Sunday'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Monday'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Tuesday'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Wednesday'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Thursday'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Friday'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'Saturday'
    END

AND CURTIME() >=
    COALESCE(so.override_start_time, sh.start_time)

AND CURTIME() <
    COALESCE(so.override_end_time, sh.end_time)

AND COALESCE(so.is_closed, 0) = 0

)
VALUES (

    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    CURDATE(),
    NULL,

parameters.query:
SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.queue_number,
    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.national_id,
    b.status,
    b.booking_date,
    sh.name AS shift,
    
    COALESCE(
        so.override_start_time,
        sh.start_time
    ) AS start_time,

    COALESCE(
        so.override_end_time,
        sh.end_time
    ) AS end_time,

    b.created_at,
    b.called_at,
    b.completed_at

FROM bookings b

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = b.patient_id

INNER JOIN shifts sh
    ON sh.id = b.shift_id

LEFT JOIN schedule_overrides so
    ON so.override_date = b.booking_date
    AND so.clinic_id = b.clinic_id
    AND so.shift_id = b.shift_id
    AND so.is_active = 1

WHERE b.doctor_id = $1
  AND b.booking_date = CURDATE()

  AND b.status IN ('Waiting', 'Serving')

  AND TIME('10:30:00') >=
      COALESCE(so.override_start_time, sh.start_time)

  AND TIME('10:30:00') <
      COALESCE(so.override_end_time, sh.end_time)

ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN 0
        WHEN b.status = 'Waiting' THEN 1
        ELSE 2
    END,
    b.queue_number;

parameters.query:
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
        0
    ) AS serving_count,

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN b.id
        END
    ) AS booking_id,

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN b.queue_number
        END
    ) AS queue_number,

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN b.patient_id
        END
    ) AS patient_id,

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN b.status = 'Serving' THEN p.full_name
        END
    ) AS patient_name

FROM bookings b

LEFT JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = b.patient_id

WHERE b.doctor_id = $1
  AND b.booking_date = CURDATE();

SELECT
    (
        SELECT b.id
        FROM bookings b
        WHERE b.doctor_id = $1
          AND b.booking_date = CURDATE()
          AND b.status = 'Waiting'
        ORDER BY b.queue_number ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS next_booking_id;

UPDATE bookings

SET
    status = 'Serving',
    called_at = NOW()

WHERE id = $1
  AND status = 'Waiting'
  AND booking_date = CURDATE();

SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.queue_number,
    b.status,
    b.booking_date,
    b.called_at,

    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.national_id,

    c.name AS clinic_name,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name,

    sh.name AS shift

FROM bookings b

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = b.patient_id

INNER JOIN clinics c
    ON c.id = b.clinic_id

LEFT JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = b.doctor_id

INNER JOIN shifts sh
    ON sh.id = b.shift_id

WHERE b.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

parameters.content: ## Patient API - Submit Payment (Invoices + Clinic Booking)

parameters.query:
SELECT
    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.national_id,

    i.id AS invoice_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_type,
    i.description,
    i.amount,
    i.status AS invoice_status,
    i.fulfillment_status,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM payments pay
        WHERE pay.invoice_id = i.id
          AND pay.status = 'Pending'
    ) AS pending_payment_count

FROM patients p

INNER JOIN invoices i
    ON i.patient_id = p.id

WHERE BINARY p.national_id = BINARY '{{ $json.body.national_id }}'
  AND i.id = {{ Number($json.body.invoice_id) }}

LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO payments (
    invoice_id,
    patient_id,
    sender_name,
    sender_phone,
    amount,
    receipt_url,
    status
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    $6,
    'Pending'
);

SELECT
    pay.id AS payment_id,
    pay.invoice_id,
    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_type,
    i.description,

    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.national_id,

    pay.sender_name,
    pay.sender_phone,

    pay.amount,
    pay.receipt_url,
    pay.status,
    pay.created_at

FROM payments pay

INNER JOIN invoices i
    ON i.id = pay.invoice_id

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = pay.patient_id

WHERE pay.invoice_id = $1
  AND pay.status = 'Pending'

ORDER BY pay.id DESC

LIMIT 1;

UPDATE payments p
INNER JOIN invoices i
    ON i.id = p.invoice_id
SET
    p.status = 'Approved',
    p.reviewed_at = NOW(),
    i.status = 'Paid',
    i.paid_at = NOW()
WHERE p.id = {{ Number($json.payment_id) }}
  AND p.status = 'Pending'
  AND i.status = 'Pending';

parameters.query:
SELECT
    pay.id AS payment_id,
    pay.invoice_id,

    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_type,
    i.description,
    i.amount AS invoice_amount,

    p.id AS patient_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.national_id,

    pay.sender_name,
    pay.sender_phone,
    pay.amount AS paid_amount,

    pay.status AS payment_status,
    i.status AS invoice_status,
    i.fulfillment_status,

    i.booking_id,
    b.queue_number,
    b.booking_date,
    c.name AS clinic_name,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name

FROM payments pay
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.id = pay.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN patients p ON p.id = pay.patient_id
LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.id = i.booking_id
LEFT JOIN clinics c ON c.id = b.clinic_id
LEFT JOIN doctors d ON d.id = b.doctor_id
WHERE pay.id = {{ Number($json.payment_id) }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    id AS invoice_id,
    invoice_number,
    patient_id,
    amount,
    status,
    fulfillment_status,
    paid_at
FROM invoices
WHERE id = {{ Number($json.body.invoice_id) }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    id AS invoice_id,
    invoice_number,
    patient_id,
    amount,
    status,
    fulfillment_status,
    paid_at
FROM invoices
WHERE id = {{ Number($('Webhook Complete Fulfillment').first().json.body.invoice_id) }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    id AS patient_id,
    full_name AS patient_name,
    national_id
FROM patients
WHERE BINARY national_id =
      BINARY '{{ $('Webhook Create Clinic Booking Invoice').first().json.body.national_id }}'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.queue_number AS your_queue_number,
    b.status AS your_status,

    c.id AS clinic_id,
    c.name AS clinic_name,

    d.id AS doctor_id,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name,

    b.booking_date,
    b.shift_id,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT MAX(sb.queue_number)
            FROM bookings sb
            WHERE sb.booking_date = CURDATE()
              AND sb.doctor_id = b.doctor_id
              AND sb.shift_id = b.shift_id
              AND sb.status = 'Serving'
        ),
        0
    ) AS current_queue_number,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM bookings wb
        INNER JOIN invoices wi
            ON wi.booking_id = wb.id
           AND wi.invoice_type = 'Clinic'
           AND wi.status = 'Paid'
        WHERE wb.booking_date = CURDATE()
          AND wb.doctor_id = b.doctor_id
          AND wb.shift_id = b.shift_id
          AND wb.status = 'Waiting'
          AND wb.queue_number < b.queue_number
    ) AS people_ahead

FROM bookings b

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = b.patient_id

INNER JOIN clinics c
    ON c.id = b.clinic_id

LEFT JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = b.doctor_id

INNER JOIN invoices i
    ON i.booking_id = b.id
   AND i.invoice_type = 'Clinic'
   AND i.status = 'Paid'

WHERE BINARY p.national_id =
      BINARY '{{ $json.query.national_id }}'

  AND b.booking_date = CURDATE()

  AND b.status IN ('Waiting', 'Serving')

ORDER BY b.id DESC

LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    b.id AS booking_id,
    b.patient_id,
    b.clinic_id,
    b.doctor_id,
    b.schedule_id,
    b.schedule_override_id,
    b.shift_id,
    b.booking_date,
    b.status
FROM bookings b
WHERE b.patient_id = $1
  AND b.clinic_id = $2
  AND b.booking_date = CURDATE()
ORDER BY b.id DESC
LIMIT 1;
